minecraft_ash.description: Loose clusters of tiny dark gray square specks floating above the horizon in front and threequarter views at t3, thinning at t8, gone by t20; a few dark gray specks sit among the background debris field in top view at t8
minecraft_ash.notes: Particles are small and dark; easy to confuse with the background dirt debris in the top view

minecraft_composter.description: Every cell shows flat grass and sky baseline; top t8 contains only the persistent brown dirt-debris chunks seen in all sheets
minecraft_composter.notes: No effect pixels detected; only the known background debris field

minecraft_dolphin.description: Small cluster of saturated blue square specks floating mid-sky in front and threequarter views at t3, reduced to a couple of specks at t8, invisible at t20; nothing in top view beyond background debris
minecraft_dolphin.notes: Blue specks read clearly against sky; low count makes them easy to miss

minecraft_dust_plume.description: A handful of pale grayish-white specks near the top edge of frame in front and threequarter views at t3 only; all other cells are baseline or background debris
minecraft_dust_plume.notes: Specks partially clipped at top edge of frame; very few pixels

minecraft_explosion.description: A clean stepped diagonal line of solid pale-cream square billboards rising from grass into the sky, visible in front view at t3 only; all other cells baseline or background debris
minecraft_explosion.notes: Distinctive staircase formation; oddly absent from threequarter view at the same tick

minecraft_falling_water.description: Tiny clusters of saturated blue square specks just above ground level in front and threequarter views at t3; a small cluster of blue specks hugs the lower-right edge of the debris pile in top view at t3; gone by t8
minecraft_falling_water.notes: Particles sit low near the ground; blue specks in top view partly overlap the debris pile

minecraft_item_cobweb.description: Small white pixel-textured sprite shapes (tiny square sprites with a web-like white pattern) floating low over grass in front and threequarter views at t3, one tiny speck at t8; top view at t3 shows two larger white sprite shapes around the debris pile
minecraft_item_cobweb.notes: White sprite shapes are larger than typical specks in top view; could be an item-icon particle

minecraft_note.description: A single small brown dirt-textured square speck low over grass in threequarter view at t8; every other cell is baseline or background debris
minecraft_note.notes: The lone speck is texture-identical to background dirt debris; cannot confirm it belongs to the effect

minecraft_shriek.description: A thin pale-cyan ellipse ring outline high in the sky in front view at t3 only; all other cells baseline or background debris
minecraft_shriek.notes: Ring is thin and faint; seen nearly edge-on as a narrow ellipse

minecraft_vault_connection.description: One or two tiny ochre/tan specks at t8: a speck at horizon level in front view, a speck high in threequarter view, and a single solid mustard-yellow square among the debris field in top view; nothing at t3 or t20
minecraft_vault_connection.notes: Only a couple of particles captured; yellow square in top view is the clearest, the rest are marginal specks

superheroes_chaos_orb.description: Loose clusters of tiny multicolored pixel-textured specks (orange, yellow, green, teal, brown) floating mid-sky in front and threequarter views at t3 and t8, dispersing into a few pale specks by t20; top view at t20 shows large translucent mustard-yellow square billboards plus one dark vertical slab on the right side
superheroes_chaos_orb.notes: Top-view t20 yellow billboards and dark slab are odd; possibly the same effect seen edge-on from above

superheroes_homelander_iron_fists_impact.description: A large soft diffuse pale pinkish-white cloud floating high in the sky in front view at t3 only; all other cells baseline or background debris
superheroes_homelander_iron_fists_impact.notes: Cloud is large but very soft; low contrast against the sky

superheroes_kratos_hand_burst_1.description: Small clusters of tiny white square/diamond specks floating above the horizon in front and threequarter views at all three ticks, most at t3, thinning to one or two faint specks by t20; nothing in top view beyond background debris
superheroes_kratos_hand_burst_1.notes: Consistent small white flecks across ticks; subtle but clearly non-baseline

superheroes_naruto_clone_poof.description: Sparse pale cream/beige specks floating mid-sky in front and threequarter views at t3 and t8, nearly gone by t20; top view at t20 shows a single pale beige irregular puffy cloud shape
superheroes_naruto_clone_poof.notes: The top-view cream blob at t20 is the clearest signal; side views only show faint specks

superheroes_scorpion_teleport.description: Two small brown dirt-textured square chunks resting low over grass in threequarter view at t8; every other cell is baseline or background debris
superheroes_scorpion_teleport.notes: The chunks are texture-identical to the persistent background dirt debris; no distinctly non-background particles visible

vfxlab_laser_beam.description: A bright saturated cyan tapered streak clipping through the top edge of frame in front view at all three ticks, shifting rightward across ticks; threequarter and top views show nothing beyond baseline and background debris
vfxlab_laser_beam.notes: Beam is clipped at the top edge of the frame so full extent is not visible; front view only

world_event_ANIMATION_VAULT_ACTIVATE.description: Every cell shows flat grass and sky baseline; top view t8 contains only the persistent brown dirt-debris chunks seen in all sheets
world_event_ANIMATION_VAULT_ACTIVATE.notes: No effect pixels detected; the activation animation may fall outside the capture ticks

world_event_PARTICLES_SCULK_CHARGE.description: Every cell shows flat grass and sky baseline; top view t8 contains only the persistent brown dirt-debris chunks seen in all sheets
world_event_PARTICLES_SCULK_CHARGE.notes: No effect pixels detected; debris field identical in character to other sheets

world_event_PARTICLES_SMASH_ATTACK.description: Every cell shows flat grass and sky baseline; top view t8 shows a cluster of brown dirt-textured chunks that match the persistent background debris field seen across all sheets
world_event_PARTICLES_SMASH_ATTACK.notes: The top-view dirt chunks could plausibly be thrown debris from a smash, but they are texture-identical to the persistent background debris in every other sheet, so they cannot be attributed to the effect

world_event_PARTICLES_WATER_EVAPORATING.description: Top view at t3 shows a dense cluster of large opaque black square particles with irregular pixelated edges surrounding the debris pile; front view at t3 shows a small cluster of pale cream/beige pixel specks clipped at the top edge of frame; everything else baseline or background debris
world_event_PARTICLES_WATER_EVAPORATING.notes: Two different particle looks in one shot: bold black squares from above and faint cream specks from the front; the black cluster is unambiguous
